lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {X : ℝ → E} {z : E} {α T : ℝ},
  0 ≤ α →
    0 ≤ T →
      Differentiable ℝ f →
        StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
          IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
            ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc 0 T) →
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt X (-gradient f (X t)) (Set.Ici t) t) →
                ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 T,
                  0 ≤ f (X t) - f z ∧
                    f (X t) - f z ≤
                      if α = 0 then ‖X 0 - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * t) else α / (2 * (Real.exp (α * t) - 1)) * ‖X 0 - z‖ ^ 2
approved_definition_context: Differentiable R f means Frechet differentiable everywhere. gradient f x is the Riesz representative of its derivative in the specified complete real inner-product space.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ a f means f((1-lambda)*x+lambda*y)<= (1-lambda)*f(x)+lambda*f(y)-(a/2)*lambda*(1-lambda)*norm(y-x)^2 for all x,y and lambda in [0,1].

Set.Icc a b is [a,b]; Set.Ico a b is [a,b); Set.Ioc a b is (a,b]; Set.Ici t is [t,infinity). HasDerivWithinAt X v (Set.Ici t) t is its right derivative at t equal to v. ContinuousOn is relative continuity, including both endpoints of a closed interval.
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x. An if expression chooses its first branch if its equality condition holds and otherwise its second branch.
